recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7374 unless the work group later rewrites the extensibility examples for reasons independent of this resolved clarification.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request from the 2015 May ballot asking to clarify that, in the second contained-extension example, the registrar field/nested extension was defined separately rather than implying that the whole contained extension was separately defined.
initial_application: Jira records SVN revision 7374. Git-svn commit 5a87e1cdb34dfa6ce424f5e9eec06c04936f50f4, "#7374 - clarify extension wording", changed source/extensibility.html from "In the second case, the contained extension is defined separately" to wording naming the nested "registrar" extension as the separately defined extension.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps the Extension type page to extensibility, so source/extensibility.html is current build input. Later commit eae5c029592e935cbfff8c077e99c9481ee7f6f4 replaced the old clinical-trial/registrar example with the current citizenship/passport-number example, but the current prose and example retain the same distinction between locally defined extension parts and an additional nested extension with its own definition. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk is needed because the current source already distinguishes complex extension content from an additional extension defined separately, and the current example identifies passport-number as the separately defined extension rather than the whole containing citizenship extension.
